items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: Fahs and Sal Franzella were very close. Well, I say friends.

ctx.x: Well, I have a few little questions. I'd be glad if you would. Okay. Uh, we covered a lot of territory. Uh, what kind of reeds did Fahs use? You were talking about something? Vandora.

He liked them. He liked them. He, uh, he much preferred the Vandora reeds than anything else. And, uh, when he didn't have, uh, money to buy a box, well, I would pick out the very best reeds in the box for him. And, uh, at that time, uh, Fahs and Sal Franzella were very close. Well, I say friends. They were, uh, Fahs was a great, great jazz musician. And, uh, Sal Franzella was, uh, historically a tremendously well-trained saxophonist in China. He later played with Paul Whiteman. And, uh, New Orleans is full of…
